theorems.name: Submission.varifold_tangents_dlb_hasDensity_of_closedBall_scaling
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (μ ν : Measure (Euclidean N)) (y z : Euclidean N) (t δ : ℝ) (c θ : ℝ≥0∞), 0 < t → 0 < δ → c ≠ ∞ → (∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ < δ → ν (closedBall y ρ) = c * (ENNReal.ofReal (t⁻¹ ^ n) * μ (closedBall z (t * ρ)))) → HasDensity n μ z θ → HasDensity n ν y (c * θ)
